reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific, testable mechanism—thermal annealing to enhance local compositional order, thereby reducing lattice disorder and promoting superconductivity—that is not stated or proposed as future work in any passage. While the passages note that disorder can suppress Tc (P1, P11) and that crystallinity correlates with superconductivity (P1), none suggest annealing as an intervention to control disorder and enhance Tc, nor do they link annealing to softer phonon modes. The idea of using annealing to tune local order and thereby mediate superconductivity is a non-trivial synthesis that goes beyond the reported observations.
